scene: The pulled lever unlocks spinning gears, unbarring three whirring exit portals.
picture: Side view along level cobblestones. Far left, a glass revolving door lift glows with upward arrows. Centre-left, the player holds a lever beside the smiling tin keeper robot. Up high over the centre, a striped gondola sways at an iron boarding gate. Far right, a sleek pneumatic tube pod waits open.
shown: a glass revolving door lift standing open on the far left
a striped rooftop gondola car moored up high above the centre
a clear pneumatic tube pod sitting open on the far right
